label: Antigravity CLI (agy, Antigravity 2.0)
notes: The Antigravity CLI (binary agy, part of Antigravity 2.0) reads workspace skills from <workspace-root>/.agents/skills/ (shared with the IDE and app) and global skills from ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/, not the IDE's ~/.gemini/config/skills/. For both surfaces at user scope, install --agent antigravity,antigravity-cli.
caveats: Docs were read through a summarizing web fetch, not verbatim; re-check before quoting.
The CLI does not read ~/.agents/skills/ (per Google's skills codelab), so a user-scope install for another agent does not reach it.
Skills are listed inside a session with /skills; agy has no terminal command that lists them, and it needs a Google sign-in.

--agent auto detects Antigravity from .agents/rules/ or .agents/rules.json (its workspace rules, per antigravity.google/docs/rules) or the legacy .agent/ folder. .agents/skills/ alone is not a marker: many agents share it.
